qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between the M10 8.8 and M10 10.9 bolts in the trailer hitch assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: The M10 10.9 bolts require 59 Nm while the M10 8.8 bolts require 42 Nm, a difference of 17 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which component uses the highest torque specification in the trailer hitch assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: The M40 slotted nut for the take-up pipe to hitch connection at 220 Nm
